INSERT INTO public.user_state (chat_id, step, period, theme, pay, lr, "offset", anchor_date)
VALUES ($1, 'main', NULL, 'all', 'all', 0, 0, NULL)
ON CONFLICT (chat_id) DO UPDATE
SET step        = EXCLUDED.step,
    period      = EXCLUDED.period,
    theme       = EXCLUDED.theme,
    pay         = EXCLUDED.pay,
    lr          = EXCLUDED.lr,
    "offset"    = EXCLUDED."offset",
    anchor_date = EXCLUDED.anchor_date
RETURNING *;

/* SQL #5 — Read-only state for invalid fallback (always returns 1 row) */

WITH s AS (
  SELECT * FROM public.user_state WHERE chat_id = $1
)
SELECT
  COALESCE((SELECT chat_id FROM s), $1)        AS chat_id,
  COALESCE((SELECT step FROM s), 'main')       AS step,
  (SELECT period FROM s)                       AS period,
  COALESCE((SELECT theme FROM s), 'all')       AS theme,
  COALESCE((SELECT pay FROM s), 'all')         AS pay,
  COALESCE((SELECT lr FROM s), 0)              AS lr,
  COALESCE((SELECT "offset" FROM s), 0)        AS "offset",
  (SELECT anchor_date FROM s)                  AS anchor_date,
  COALESCE((SELECT updated_at FROM s), now())  AS updated_at,
  (SELECT user_state_id FROM s)                AS user_state_id;

INSERT INTO public.user_state (chat_id, step, "offset")
VALUES ($1, 'main', 0)
ON CONFLICT (chat_id) DO UPDATE
SET step     = EXCLUDED.step,
    "offset" = EXCLUDED."offset"
RETURNING *;

INSERT INTO public.user_state (chat_id, theme, step)
VALUES ($1, $2, 'main2')
ON CONFLICT (chat_id) DO UPDATE
SET theme = EXCLUDED.theme,
    step  = EXCLUDED.step
RETURNING *;

INSERT INTO public.user_state (chat_id, pay, step)
VALUES ($1, CASE WHEN $2 IN ('free','all') THEN $2 ELSE 'all' END, 'main')
ON CONFLICT (chat_id) DO UPDATE
SET pay = EXCLUDED.pay
RETURNING *;

INSERT INTO public.user_state (chat_id, step, period)
VALUES ($1, 'main', $2)
ON CONFLICT (chat_id) DO UPDATE
SET period = EXCLUDED.period
RETURNING *;

/* v2|set|lr=<0|1>  (lr + step=main)
Do NOT set anchor_date or "offset"; trigger handles offset reset.
*/
INSERT INTO public.user_state (chat_id, step, lr)
VALUES ($1, 'main', $2::smallint)
ON CONFLICT (chat_id) DO UPDATE
SET lr   = EXCLUDED.lr
RETURNING *;

/* Why wrap: if Query A returns 0 rows, n8n would otherwise stop and you can’t render “Brak wyników…”. The wrapper returns exactly 1 row always with row_count, has_more, rows.*/

/* S2-07B — Query A wrapper: always returns 1 row (rows=[], row_count=0 if no results) */
WITH
state AS (
  SELECT
    us.chat_id,
    us.period,
    us.theme,
    us.pay,
    us.lr,
    us."offset" AS offset_n,
    us.anchor_date
  FROM public.user_state us
  WHERE us.chat_id = $1
  LIMIT 1
),
date_window AS (
  SELECT
    CASE s.period
      WHEN 'today'    THEN s.anchor_date
      WHEN 'tomorrow' THEN s.anchor_date + 1
      WHEN 'week'     THEN s.anchor_date
      WHEN 'weekend'  THEN s.anchor_date
                       + ((6 - EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM s.anchor_date)::int + 7) % 7)
      ELSE s.anchor_date
    END AS start_date,
    CASE s.period
      WHEN 'today'    THEN s.anchor_date
      WHEN 'tomorrow' THEN s.anchor_date + 1
      WHEN 'week'     THEN s.anchor_date + 6
      WHEN 'weekend'  THEN (s.anchor_date
                       + ((6 - EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM s.anchor_date)::int + 7) % 7)) + 1
      ELSE s.anchor_date
    END AS end_date
  FROM state s
  WHERE s.period IS NOT NULL AND s.anchor_date IS NOT NULL
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT
    e.*,
    cat.category_raw
  FROM public.events e
  CROSS JOIN state s
  CROSS JOIN date_window w
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT NULLIF(elc.raw_value, '__MISSING__') AS category_raw
    FROM public.event_listings el
    JOIN public.event_listing_categories elc
      ON elc.listing_id = el.listing_id
    WHERE el.event_id = e.event_id
    ORDER BY
      CASE
        WHEN el.source = e.primary_source AND e.primary_url IS NOT NULL AND el.url = e.primary_url THEN 0
        WHEN el.source = e.primary_source THEN 1
        ELSE 2
      END,
      CASE WHEN elc.raw_value = '__MISSING__' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
      elc.raw_value ASC
    LIMIT 1
  ) cat ON TRUE
  WHERE e.date BETWEEN w.start_date AND w.end_date
    AND (s.pay = 'all' OR e.pay_best = s.pay)
    AND (s.lr = 1 OR e.range_days < 21)
    AND (
      s.theme = 'all'
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.event_tags et
        JOIN public.tags t ON t.tag_id = et.tag_id
        WHERE et.event_id = e.event_id
          AND t.kind = 'theme'
          AND t.code = s.theme
          AND t.enabled IS TRUE
      )
    )
),
ordered_paged AS (
  SELECT
    e.event_id,
    e.date,
    e.title_display,
    e.times_text,
    e.venue_best,
    e.pay_best,
    e.category_raw,
    e.primary_url,
    e.earliest_time
  FROM filtered e
  ORDER BY
    e.date ASC,
    e.earliest_time ASC NULLS LAST,
    e.title_display ASC,
    e.event_id ASC
  OFFSET (SELECT offset_n FROM state)
  LIMIT ($2 + 1)
),
meta AS (
  SELECT (COUNT(*) > $2) AS has_more
  FROM ordered_paged
),
q AS (
  SELECT
    op.event_id,
    op.date,
    op.title_display,
    op.times_text,
    op.venue_best,
    op.pay_best,
    op.category_raw,
    op.primary_url,
    (SELECT has_more FROM meta) AS has_more
  FROM ordered_paged op
  ORDER BY
    op.date ASC,
    op.earliest_time ASC NULLS LAST,
    op.title_display ASC,
    op.event_id ASC
  LIMIT $2
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(q)), '[]'::jsonb) AS rows,
    COALESCE(bool_or(q.has_more), false)          AS has_more,
    COUNT(*)                                     AS row_count
  FROM q
)
SELECT
  COALESCE((SELECT theme FROM state), 'all') AS theme,
  COALESCE((SELECT pay FROM state), 'all')   AS pay,
  COALESCE((SELECT lr FROM state), 0)        AS lr,
  COALESCE((SELECT offset_n FROM state), 0)  AS offset_n,
  rows, has_more, row_count
FROM agg;

INSERT INTO public.user_state (chat_id, step, theme, pay, lr, "offset")
VALUES ($1, 'main', 'all', 'all', 0, 10)
ON CONFLICT (chat_id) DO UPDATE
SET step = 'main',
    "offset" = public.user_state."offset" + 10
RETURNING *;

SET "offset" = GREATEST("offset" - 10, 0)
WHERE chat_id = $1
RETURNING *;
